npcc_ows_mbt_anti_armor_missiles.name: Anti-Armor Missiles
npcc_ows_mbt_antitank_gun.name: Anti-Tank Gun
npcc_ows_mbt_antitank_gun.on_crit.detail: The target becomes Shredded until the end of their next turn.
npcc_ows_mbt_armament_loadout.effect: The MBT chooses one Main Gun and one Secondary Gun.
npcc_ows_mbt_armament_loadout.name: Armament Loadout
npcc_ows_mbt_composite_armor.effect: One side of the MBT is an armored facing (choose one side of its token/icon/miniature). All characters can identify this facing. Attacks and effects that trace a line directly to this facing treat the MBT as though it has Armor 6 and Resistance to damage from Blast, Burst, Line, and Cone attacks and effects. AP damage, burn, and damage taken by the MBT while it is Shredded are all still reduced by 2 when coming from attacks and effects made against this facing. Mines and other proximity-based systems ignore this trait. Whenever the MBT makes a standard move or Boost, it can change which side its armored facing is on.
npcc_ows_mbt_composite_armor.name: Composite Armor
npcc_ows_mbt_full_tracked.effect: The MBT must always move in a straight line, although it can move and Boost in separate directions. Additionally, the MBT can’t climb, swim, manipulate objects, or make melee attacks other than Ram, but it ignores difficult terrain and has Immunity to Prone.
npcc_ows_mbt_full_tracked.name: Full Tracked
npcc_ows_mbt_hover_tank.effect: The MBT ignores dangerous terrain, and its movement no longer needs to be in a straight line.
npcc_ows_mbt_hover_tank.name: Hover Tank
npcc_ows_mbt_marker_nexus.name: Marker Nexus
npcc_ows_mbt_marker_nexus.on_hit.detail: The target must pass a Systems save or gain Lock On and become Impaired until the end of their next turn.
npcc_ows_mbt_mobile_bunker.effect: Adjacent allied characters can use the MBT for hard cover. Characters gain Resistance to damage from Blast, Burst, Line, and Cone attacks while benefiting from this cover.
npcc_ows_mbt_mobile_bunker.name: Mobile Bunker
npcc_ows_mbt_multidirectional_charges.ef: This weapon ignores penalties from Engaged.
This weapon can attack two targets at a time.
npcc_ows_mbt_rolling_thunder.effect: The MBT can't take the Grunt Template, and only a single MBT may be present in any scene
npcc_ows_mbt_rolling_thunder.name: Rolling Thunder
npcc_ows_mbt_secondary_gunner.effect: The MBT may make attacks with its Secondary Weapon even while Jammed or Stunned.
npcc_ows_mbt_secondary_gunner.name: Secondary Gunner
npcc_ows_mbt_siege_mode.action_siege_mod: The MBT extends (or retracts) stabilizers that cause it to become Immobilized as long as this system is active. While extended, the MBT's Main Gun gains Arcing and +5 Range (+5 Line if it is a Line weapon), but the MBT cannot make ranged attacks against or centered on characters, objects, or spaces within Range 3 using its Main Gun.
While Siege Mode is active, the MBT's Main Gun gains +5 Range (or +5 Line if it is a Line weapon) but cannot make ranged attacks against or centered on characters, objects, or spaces within Range 3.
npcc_ows_mbt_siege_mode.effect: The MBT extends (or retracts) stabilizers that cause it to become Immobilized as long as this system is active. While extended, the MBT’s Main Gun gains Arcing and +5 Range (+5 Line if it is a Line weapon), but the MBT cannot make ranged attacks against or centered on characters, objects, or spaces within Range 3 using its Main Gun
npcc_ows_mbt_siege_mode.name: Siege Mode
npcc_ows_mbt_skylight_laser.name: Skylight Anti-Air Laser
npcc_ows_mbt_skylight_laser.on_hit.detai:
If the target is flying, they must pass an Agility save or choose one:
  • They take +1d6 bonus damage.
  • They immediately land (this counts as falling without any damage) and become unable to fly until the end of their next turn.
npcc_ows_mbt_smokescreen.action_smokescr: The MBT creates a Blast 2 area of dense, sensor-jamming smoke within Range 5, and may immediately Boost into it as a free action. This area lasts until the end of the MBT’s next turn, and all characters and objects within it gain soft cover. The first time the MBT and any allied characters enter this area, they clear Lock On.
npcc_ows_mbt_smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
npcc_ows_mbt_smoothbore_cannon.effect: This weapon deals {10/20/30} AP Explosive Damage to objects, cover, and terrain.
npcc_ows_mbt_smoothbore_cannon.name: Smoothbore Cannon
npcc_ows_mbt_smoothbore_cannon.on_miss.d: A Size 1 section of any object adjacent to the target (e.g., cover, deployable equipment, buildings, or terrain), takes {10/20/30} Explosive Damage.
npcc_ows_mbt_stabilized_railgun.name: Stabilized Railgun
npcc_ows_mbt_stable_body.effect: The MBT can’t be pushed, pulled, or knocked back by smaller characters. If a hostile effect would move the MBT 2 or more spaces or knock it Prone (even if the MBT would ignore that effect due to Immunity or movement caused by a smaller character) that character may change which side its armored facing is on after that effect resolves. Characters may also Ram the MBT to change which side its armored facing is on regardless of their Size.
npcc_ows_mbt_stable_body.name: Stable Body
npcc_ows_mbt_streetsweeper.effect: This attack’s Cone area cannot change directions when fired.
npcc_ows_mbt_streetsweeper.name: "Streetsweeper" Canister Projector
npcc_ows_mbt_tank_shock.effect: The MBT ignores engagement and can pass through, but not stop in, spaces occupied by other characters and obstructions smaller than Size 3. The MBT destroys any objects it passes through this way, and if it passes through any characters, those characters are pushed out of the way as directly as possible if able. Passing through characters as part of a Boost also means those characters must, 1/turn, pass a Hull save or take {4/5/6} Kinetic Damage and be knocked Prone.
npcc_ows_mbt_tank_shock.name: Tank Shock
npcc_ows_mbt.flavor: With a history stretching back to the earliest days of pre-Fall armored warfare, the tank remains a core component of modern military doctrine even in the era of mechanized combat chassis. Despite countless technological advances, the overall design of the modern main battle tank (or MBT) remains immediately recognizable: an armored vehicle housing a large, turreted primary weapon supplemented by secondary armaments, blending firepower, protective countermeasures, and mobility into a multipurpose unit capable of both offensive and defensive maneuvers. While chassis tend to be much more flexible and configurable strike platforms, tanks make up for this with the ability to mount heavier armor without compromising their ability to employ large-caliber weaponry on the move. The sheer variety of tank configurations that can be found throughout the galaxy is perhaps more diverse than even chassis variants, with different states, militaries, and even private armies all favoring models suited their preferred combat doctrines.
npcc_ows_mbt.name: MBT
npcc_ows_mbt.tactics: The MBT is a heavily armed and armored “set-piece” unit that can quickly overwhelm enemies with its combination of speed and firepower. It can quickly deal a tremendous amount of damage using Barrage with its main gun and secondary weapon as well as by using Tank Shock to run over other characters, and Composite Armor makes it incredibly resilient. These advantages must be balanced with both the restrictions to its movement and its visible armored facing, which make it vulnerable to being flanked. Choosing when to fire from range and when to press the attack are key to getting the most out of this unit
npcc_ows_mbt.terse: The MBT is a heavily armed and armored unit that can quickly overwhelm enemies with its combination of speed and firepower, but it’s vulnerable to being flanked.
npcf_marine_battering_ram.effect: The Marine deals {10/20/30} Kinetic AP to an adjacent piece of terrain, obstruction, or Deployable. They may move 2 spaces before or after using this system.
npcf_marine_battering_ram.name: Battering Ram
npcf_marine_captive_spike.effect:
The Marine deploys a powerful piston spike against an adjacent hostile character. The target must pass a Hull save. On a success, they become Impaired until the end of their next turn. On a failure, they are impaled on the spike, and become automatically Grappled and Impaired for the duration of the grapple. The Marine becomes Slowed for the duration of the grapple, but is automatically treated as the larger character regardless of Size. Breaking free from this grapple requires the defender to pass a Hull save as a full action rather than a contested Hull check.
While the target is Grappled this way, any other character that makes a ranged or melee attack against the Marine must first roll 1d6: on 4+, the attack automatically hits the Grappled character instead, dealing half dam age and heat. This effect does not stack with Invisible. This effect lasts until the grapple is ended or until the Marine takes this action again.
npcf_marine_captive_spike.name: Captive Spike
npcf_marine_deck_anchors.action_deck_anc: The Marine is involuntarily moved by another character’s attack or as a result of failing a save forced by another character. This excludes teleportation.
npcf_marine_deck_anchors.name: Deck Anchors
npcf_marine_filo.effect: Reaction attacks against the Marine (e.g., Overwatch) recieve +1 Difficulty.
npcf_marine_filo.name: First On, Last Off
npcf_marine_manuverable.effect: The Marine moves normally in zero-g.
npcf_marine_manuverable.name: Manuverable
npcf_marine_pointman_plating.effect: If the Marine does not have the Guardian trait, then adjacent allied characters can use the Marine for hard cover. If they already have Guardian, then Guardian additionally grants soft cover to all adjacent allies from all directions.
npcf_marine_pointman_plating.name: Pointman Plating
npcf_marine_portable_barricade.deployabl: A burst 1 area around this barricade counts as difficult terrain for hostile characters only.
npcf_marine_portable_barricade.effect: The Marine can deploy a Size 1 barrier in a free adjacent area for each charge expended when they activate this system. These barriers have 10 HP and Evasion 5, and a burst1 area around each barrier counts as difficult terrain for hostile characters only.
npcf_marine_portable_barricade.name: Portable Barricade
npct_marine.description: Naval boarding and counterboarding actions are among some of the most dangerous operations that pilots can undertake in some of the most treacherous environments imaginable. High casualty rates on both sides are expected and accepted by the commanders who order these soldiers to assault ships and stations or to repel those who seek to take them. Marine pilots know that preparedness is the key to survival and out- fit their chassis accordingly with additional armor, breaching equipment, and close-quarters engagement tools to help tip the odds in their favor when the hullcutter charges blow.
npct_marine.name: Marine
